propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' errors for bare 4-hex commit subject prefixes that match multiple tickets, then the process hangs for minutes despite the close having already committed durably.

The blame module's _find_fixing_commit re-resolves bug_id on every commit in the entire branch history and rescans alias JSON files, creating an O(commits × tickets) complexity that causes ~9 minutes of unnecessary filesystem work.

The blame module passes no quiet=True flag to resolution scanners, unlike close_precheck, allowing unqualified 4-hex candidates from commit subjects to print ambiguity diagnostics the user never supplied.
Bare 4-digit (single-quad) hex references should no longer be advertised as a supported reference form in documentation, though resolution compatibility is retained.

A hex-quad short-circuit must reject candidates that do not start-match the target's canonical id, preventing unnecessary alias scans for unrelated fragments while preserving all existing resolution outcomes.
